decision: Candidate v3 may proceed to prospective confirmatory campaign planning. This development result does not activate confirmation, consume alpha, establish statistical significance, or authorize inspection of confirmatory outcomes before the complete campaign freeze.
limitations: This bounded development screen is not a confirmatory effect estimate or significance test.
The seven paired language measurements include six independent physical clusters and one evidence mask paired to run 001; the mask adds zero independent clusters.
Run 003 exposed a retained mismatch between the generic complete-reference next check and the proposed method's non-triggered recommendation; no answer or label was repaired.
Run 006's two R failures arise from different retained Luna-v7 measurements, including a pass-2 mechanism-identification label that is internally inconsistent with its rationale.

A confirmatory campaign still requires prospective freezing of the selected candidate and baseline, exact Luna configuration and references, scenario distribution, guardrails, alpha allocation, stopping rules, and fresh replication reservation.
